commit.message:
fix(ces): fix duplicate symbol link failure in static_subscriber_manager_unit_test

The indep test gate failed to link static_subscriber_manager_unit_test:
AccessTokenHelper::GetHapTokenID and three OsAccountManagerHelper methods
collide between the test mocks and libcesfwk_services_static.a.

Root cause: static_subscriber_manager.cpp now calls the free function
IsUserAppSubscriberType() (defined in common_event_subscriber_manager.cpp),
which pulls common_event_subscriber_manager.o and its transitive closure
(subscriber_death_recipient.o -> common_event_manager_service.o ->
inner_common_event_manager.o) from the static library into the test link.
Those members reference VerifyShellToken/CheckUserExists and drag in
access_token_helper.o and os_account_manager_helper.o, whose strong
definitions clash with the strong mocks.

Fix follows the existing convention introduced by 'use static library in
test' (1624ef4f): mark the mocked real implementations as
__attribute__((weak)) so strong mocks override them at link time.
Production behaviour is unchanged.

Verified with full indep test build (standard variant): 0 duplicate
symbol errors and all service unit test binaries linked successfully.
